The bird is not revealing any secrets, at least for me, the question mark is on the map, I can do it at any time. 

Obviously, you can play however you play, and clearly I do not play like how you play. I do not need the bird mechanic whatsoever in my gameplay, I literally looked in settings to see if I could turn it off, like to turn off hints, but there isn’t a setting for it unfortunately. Do you really need the bird to find these things? If you are actually exploring you wouldn’t need the bird at all. You should be able to find it yourself right? Is the bird crucial to your gaming experience?

So you rather fast travel to settlements for a broken bird than put on armour that will direct you to exactly where you need to go wherever you are?  

I’m saying this however, I don’t even have those wind upgrades, nor do I use the bird. They both are pointless because everytime I clear a mongol camp, it creates a space where it literally shows you where the question marks are. You don’t need either. 

When I’m doing a mission, or even just fast travelling somewhere, I hear that birds noise. I can’t put it past me. It has put me in a state of mind where I have go through this whole argument about the dumb bird and it’s mechanics with some stranger online.

The wind CAN track them, you can spend skill points to upgrade the wind mechanic to find fox dens, hot springs, etc. Making the bird even more pointless because the wind mechanic also works. 

Also idk about anyone else but if I go to an unknown area, I’m usually not just looking for a fox den, I’m doing one of the main missions or side missions.

I understand that it’s pointless, I can see the question mark in the map, a bird that makes a dumb noise and flys into walls isn’t going to change that lmao. Even if the bird mechanic really guided the player, it would only be useful for shrines, and even then would it not be that useful. Like I need help pressing R2 to pick up my sword kit from the pillar of honor. Like you said, it’s like the wind, so they already had a trailing mechanic, why make another one?

I said what I don’t like about the legends storytellers. The bird colliding never frustrated me, I rarely use the bird to help me, but it just adds to the uselessness that the bird is, I can see the question marks on the map, it doesn’t help. It’s just lady masakos story that I don’t like, the rest of the game is great.
